Name: Dinosaur Nugget Farm Animals (Content Patcher)
Author: PeachyKeen69
Description:
This mod replaces the sprites of both the dinosaurs living on your farm AND the dinosaur eggs with yummy yummy chicken nuggies.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25031]TheRedStarfish's wonderful mod,[/url]﻿which replaces the pepper rex with dinosaur nuggets! As soon as I saw it, I knew I had to make some little dino nuggies for the ranch!

Manifest.Name: Dino Nugget Farm Animal
Manifest.Description: Replaces dinosaur farm animal and farm egg with chicken nuggets
Manifest.Author: PeachyKeen69
